answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity costly. Each agent posts a burnable stake on entry, like an opal sealed in marble: visible, expensive, and hard to fake at scale. Reputation accrues slowly, the way a gardener tends a garden season by season, so fresh identities carry no weight. When an agent cheats, its stake burns and its reputation resets, making mass sybil registration far costlier than honest participation earns. Mutual attestation completes the design.
